parole.significato: mujahid (a Muslim engaging in jihad, Central Asia during 1917–26)
parole.testo: A back-formation from Uzbek bosmachi, from bosma (“raid”) + the agent suffix -chi. It was conceived as a plural form by Russian and the final vowel was dropped to create a singular form.

parole.significato: oleaster, silverberry (Elaeagnus genus and species, especially Elaeagnus angustifolia)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Uzbek жийда (jiyda) / jiyda, ultimately from Proto-Turkic *yidge.

parole.significato: the place where after a day of harvest the cotton is unloaded to be tallied
parole.testo: Borrowed from Uzbek хирмон (xirmon) (Kazakh қырман (qırman)), from Persian خرمن (xarman, xerman).

parole.significato: a square rug particularly such as tied up to collect remains of cotton on the field
parole.testo: Borrowed from Uzbek sholcha, Kyrgyz шалча (şalca, “square rug”).
